## Test checklist

- [ ] Ran it locally (`start.bat` or `npm run dev`) and the feature/fix works on the golden path
- [ ] No regressions in adjacent features (step rail, Settings, setup cards)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` all pass
- [ ] No new console errors / warnings

## Commit conventions (for auto-versioning)

| Prefix | Effect |
|--------|--------|
| `feat:` | Minor bump (0.X.0): new feature |
| `fix:` | Patch bump (0.0.X): bug fix |
| `feat!:` / `BREAKING CHANGE:` | Major bump (X.0.0) |
| `chore:` `docs:` `style:` `refactor:` | No version bump |
